Options:
  --extra EXTRA  Include an optional dependency group
  --all-extras  Include all optional dependencies
  --no-dev  Exclude development dependencies
  --locked  Require an unchanged lockfile
  --frozen  Use the lockfile without updating it
  --no-install-project  Skip installation of the current project
  --dry-run  Show planned changes
  --python PYTHON  Select a Python interpreter
  --offline  Disable network access
  --no-cache  Disable caching
  --directory DIRECTORY  Change working directory
  --project PROJECT  Select project directory
